🪟️ The browser actor ui patch offer and mounted identity messages of the backbone worker.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useBackboneWorker}: each function is one message arm of the backbone worker `onmessage` ladder, moved verbatim.

 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useBackboneWorker}: each function is one message arm of the backbone worker `onmessage` ladder, moved verbatim.

 *

🌱️ The space artifact creation catalog refresh, creation status and document check-in status messages of the backbone worker.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useBackboneWorker}: each function is one message arm of the backbone worker `onmessage` ladder, moved verbatim.

 *

 *
 * 🧱️ Child hook module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useBackboneWorker}: runs the original hook statements in order.

items.name: handleBrowserActorUiPatchMessage
items.doc: Validates a browser actor ui patch offer against the open session and answers a verdict per surface.

items.name: handleBrowserActorUiMountedMessage
items.doc: Binds the mounted browser actor identity and resolves the document ready state.

items.name: handleSocketActorMessage
items.doc: Resolves the waiter of a ready socket actor and publishes its local presence actor.

items.name: handleSocketActorFailedMessage
items.doc: Rejects the waiter of a socket actor that failed to start.

items.name: handleInferenceHistoryStatusMessage
items.doc: Folds an inference history status into the ui state of its open document.

items.name: handleSpaceArtifactCreationCatalogRefreshRequiredMessage
items.doc: Requests a fresh creation catalog when the retained one lost its authority.

items.name: handleDocumentCheckInStatusMessage
items.doc: Folds a document check-in status into the owner's ui state.

items.name: handleSpaceArtifactCreationStatusMessage
items.doc: Folds an artifact creation status into its owner and opens the ready artifact once.

items.name: handleDirectoryScopeRevokedMessage
items.doc: Retires every document, creation and ui state of a revoked directory scope.

items.name: handleDirectoryAdministrationStateMessage
items.doc: Verifies and applies a space administration page for the current epoch.

items.name: handleDirectoryAdministrationCapabilityMessage
items.doc: Copies an invite capability for the current administration transfer.

items.name: handleDirectoryCommandReceiptMessage
items.doc: Retains a command receipt and folds its accepted events into the directory.

items.name: handleArtifactBootstrapMessage
items.doc: Folds bootstrap progress, failure and rebootstrap requests into the document ui state.

items.name: handleLocalCatalogEventMessage
items.doc: Applies a local catalog document event.

items.name: handleDocumentEventMessage
items.doc: Routes a document event to its open session: status, presence, backbone, archive, command outcome and conflict.

items.name: usePluginInstallState
items.doc: Holds the plugin module url, rebuilt-at, in-flight and install progress state.
